Billing and cancelling, in plain words

Last updated: November 24, 2026

YAP VOICE is a product of YAP-AI Solutions ("I", "me", or "my"), San Diego, CA. This says what a business pays for YAP VOICE, when it pays, how to cancel, and what happens when it does. It is written to be read in a few minutes.

Plans and Prices

  • Answering + Booking: $99 a month for each business phone line. The assistant answers the calls you send it, takes the caller's name, number and what they need, takes the day and time they would like as a booking request for you to confirm, answers questions from the information you give it, and texts and emails you after each call.
  • Answering + Booking + Integration: $149 a month for each business phone line. Everything in Answering + Booking, with your own Google Calendar connected: the assistant offers callers your real open times and books, moves and cancels visits in your calendar.
  • A restaurant's line is on the $99 plan. Its booking requests are table requests, which you confirm.

There is no setup fee and no minimum term. Prices are in US dollars. If the law requires me to collect a tax on the service, it is shown before you pay.

How Many Calls a Plan Covers

Each plan covers up to 300 calls a month on its line. If a month goes over, the assistant keeps answering and you are not charged extra for that month.

If your line takes more than 300 calls a month for two months in a row, I will write to you and we agree a price that fits before anything changes. If we cannot agree, either of us can end the service at the end of the month you have paid for.

The 30-Day Free Trial

  • The trial is on either plan and starts the day your line is switched on.
  • You pay nothing during the trial, and you do not need to give a card to start it.
  • Before the trial ends I send you a payment link. If you want to carry on, you pay through it and your first paid month starts the day after the trial ends.
  • If you do not want to carry on, tell me or simply do not pay. The line is switched off when the trial ends and you owe nothing.

Paying

  • You pay monthly, in advance, by card, through Stripe. I never see or store your card number.
  • It renews automatically. Your card is charged the plan's price on the same day each month until you cancel.
  • Stripe emails you a receipt for every payment.
  • If a payment fails, Stripe tries the card again and I write to you. If it is still unpaid after 7 days, the line may be paused until it is paid. A paused line is not answered by the assistant.
  • If a price is going to change, I tell you by email at least 30 days before, and you can cancel before the new price starts.

Cancelling

  • You can cancel at any time, for any reason, with no fee. Email yap.itsupport@gmail.com from the address on your account, or tell me by phone or text.
  • Cancelling stops the next charge. The assistant keeps answering until the end of the month you have already paid for, unless you ask me to switch it off sooner.
  • If your own phone number forwards calls to the assistant, turn that forwarding off when you leave. I will show you how.

Refunds

  • A month that has already started is not refunded when you cancel.
  • If you were charged by mistake, or charged after you had cancelled, I refund that charge in full.

Your Information When You Leave

When your account closes, your phone line is released and the information held for your business is deleted, as the privacy policy describes. If you would like a copy of your setup and your enquiries first, ask before you cancel.

Changes to These Terms

If these terms change, the date at the top changes, and customers are told by email at least 30 days before a change that affects what they pay or how they cancel.

What it won't do: quote prices or promise dates on your behalf. It takes the details, and you decide.

What it does

A receptionist that never puts anyone on hold

Every item here is something it does on calls today. You choose which of them your line uses.

Answers questions

Hours, services, the area you cover — from the information you give it. When it doesn't know, it says so and takes a message instead of guessing.

Asks your questions

Set the questions for each service — "what car is it?", "which day suits you?" — and every callback arrives with the answers.

Reads the number back

When a caller gives a callback number, it's read back to them to confirm, so you don't ring a stranger over one misheard digit.

Puts callers through

If someone asks for a person, it can pass the call to your phone — only if you've switched that on and given a number.

Answers when you say

Every call, only after hours, or only when you don't pick up — you choose, and change it any time from your dashboard.

Honest with callers

It tells every caller it's an automated assistant, and tells anyone describing an emergency to hang up and call 911.

Your dashboard

Everyone waiting on you, one tap from a call back

  • Who is waiting for a call back, what they need, and a button to ring them
  • Every call your assistant answered, and how it ended
  • Your month in numbers: calls answered, how many it handled, how long they took
  • Your hours, services and answers — change them and the next call uses them
  • Works on your phone as well as your computer

Questions

What owners ask first

Will callers know it's not a person?

Yes. Every call starts with it saying it's your business's automated assistant. If someone asks whether they're talking to a robot, it answers plainly.

Do I have to change my phone number?

No. You keep the number your customers know and forward the calls you want it to answer — every call, after hours only, or when you don't pick up.

What if it can't answer a question?

It says it doesn't know rather than making something up, takes the caller's details, and you get them by text and email like any other callback.

Are calls recorded?

No. There's no audio recording and no transcript is kept. You get the details the caller gave — name, number, what they need — and a short note of what they asked for. The privacy policy has the full detail.

Can it book jobs into my calendar?

Yes, if you want it to. Connect your Google Calendar from your dashboard and, once it has taken a caller's details, the assistant offers them two open times and puts the visit in your calendar for you to confirm. It only checks when you're busy — it never reads your other events — and it only changes the visits it booked. You can disconnect it at any time. The privacy policy says exactly what it does with your calendar.

How is it set up, and what does it cost?

We set it up with you: your services, hours, the questions you want asked, and where callbacks should go. It's $99 a month per line, or $149 with your Google Calendar connected so visits are booked straight into it, and the first 30 days are free. Each plan covers up to 300 calls a month; if your line regularly takes more, we agree a price that fits before anything changes.
